main_measure.name: mean fwd 5-bar return after top-quintile |forecast| minus after neutral bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference < 0 with Welch t <= -2; reject if > 0 with t >= +2; else inconclusive; min 30 extreme cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins whose difference has the pooled sign (need >= 2)

decided_by: Welch t lies between -2 and +2, so inconclusive.
reading: Quintiles of |forecast| are taken over all pooled non-overlapping grid bars (extreme = |forecast| at or above the 80th percentile and non-zero, neutral = forecast 0 or at or below the 20th percentile), and the supporting check needs 2 coins with the pooled sign whatever the number of coins present.
